description: This file defines the TestTracing class used for capturing, managing, and saving trace events during test execution in Playwright. It handles trace recording, event appending, trace file merging, and attachment serialization.

classes.name: TestTracing
classes.description: Class responsible for managing test trace recording, including starting/stopping traces, appending events, and saving trace files.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes trace options and starts live trace file if required based on configuration.

methods.name: stopIfNeeded
methods.description: Finalizes and saves the trace, merging temporary files, and attaches the trace to the test info.

methods.name: appendForError
methods.description: Appends an error event to the trace with formatted message and stack.

methods.name: appendStdioToTrace
methods.description: Records stdout or stderr output into the trace.

methods.name: appendBeforeActionForStep
methods.description: Records a 'before' event for a test step.

methods.name: appendAfterActionForStep
methods.description: Records an 'after' event for a test step, including attachments and errors.
